# CleaningDigital

> Web design, local SEO, AI SEO, Google Ads and digital marketing exclusively for cleaning companies. Focused on Calgary, Alberta, and working remotely with cleaning company owners across Canada and the United States. Founder and Lead Strategist: Nakul Chandra.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://cleaningdigital.ca/): Overview of services for cleaning companies
- [Services](https://cleaningdigital.ca/services.html): Brand design, web design, local SEO, AI SEO, Google Business Profile, Google Ads, Meta ads, booking systems, support
- [Pricing](https://cleaningdigital.ca/pricing.html): Three fixed one-time website packages: $799, $1,299 and $1,899 CAD
- [Our work](https://cleaningdigital.ca/projects.html): Homepage designs built for cleaning companies
- [About](https://cleaningdigital.ca/about.html): Nakul Chandra and how CleaningDigital works

Here is how to write pages that earn their place.
- [Google Analytics 4 for Cleaning Company Owners: The Few Reports That Matter](https://cleaningdigital.ca/google-analytics-4-for-cleaning-company-owners.html): GA4 can feel overwhelming. A cleaning company owner only needs a handful of reports and a few key events to see what brings in leads.
- [Google Search Console for Cleaning Companies: Five Reports Worth Checking](https://cleaningdigital.ca/google-search-console-for-cleaning-companies.html): Search Console is free and shows how Google sees your cleaning company site. These are the five reports we check first.
- [Seven Questions to Ask Before Hiring a Marketing Agency for Your Cleaning Company](https://cleaningdigital.ca/questions-to-ask-before-hiring-a-cleaning-marketing-agency.html): Not every agency understands cleaning businesses. These seven questions help you tell the difference before you sign anything.
- [A Seasonal Marketing Calendar for Canadian Cleaning Companies](https://cleaningdigital.ca/seasonal-marketing-calendar-cleaning-companies-canada.html): Demand for cleaning shifts through the Canadian year. Here is a simple way to plan your marketing around the seasons.
- [How to Track Calls and Quote Requests From Your Cleaning Website](https://cleaningdigital.ca/track-calls-and-quote-requests-from-your-cleaning-website.html): If you cannot tell which marketing brings quote requests, you cannot improve it. Here is a simple tracking setup for a cleaning company.
- [Schema Markup for Cleaning Companies: What It Is and What to Add](https://cleaningdigital.ca/schema-markup-for-cleaning-companies.html): Schema markup helps search engines and AI tools understand your cleaning business. Here is what to add and what to skip.
